exposure: Temporal lobe epilepsy with hippocampal sclerosis (TLE-HS)
cohort: The study analyzed 47 pregnancies in women with Temporal lobe epilepsy with hippocampal sclerosis (TLE-HS), identified from a monocentric registry of 2320 women with epilepsy.
finding: Surgical treatment before pregnancy significantly increased the chance of seizure freedom and was associated with a lower rate of induced labor compared to medication alone.
mod_finding: The surgical treatment group showed a lower rate of induced labor, and Caesarean section was performed in 77.1% of cases, often due to seizure concerns.
